step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and input a renewal as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Earnings week 1: Enter the amount (if necessary).

Claim type: Select the appropriate option:
20 - Family caregiver for children
21 - Family caregiver for adults
No claimant’s report: If requested by the client, check the box.

step.cmd: On the Search tab, select Caregiver/Compassionate care - Patient and on the Search for Caregiver/Compassionate care patient (MCB2) screen, find the patient record as follows:

ul.li: Claimant’s SIN: Enter the client’s SIN .

step.cmd: Select the patient record to access the Caregiver/Compassionate care data entry (MCB1) screen.
Select Entitlement (M112) to access the Caregiver/Compassionate care entitlement (M112) screen.

ul.li:
Type: Select the appropriate option:
20 - Family caregiver for children
21 - Family caregiver for adults
Start date: Leave this field blank.
End date: Leave this field blank.
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of entitlement weeks.

step.cmd: Determine if, before submitting the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC, a Level 2 officer must adjudicate any outstanding issues:
In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 working days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if a decision has been rendered:
In FTS, on the Caregiver/Compassionate care data entry (MCB1) screen, update the claimant record as follows:

ul.li: Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of entitlement weeks.
Waiting period served: Leave this field blank.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “ Renewal CT [20 or 21] as of [XXXX]. [number of weeks] weeks to be paid. Window [XXXX] to [XXXX]."
Remarks line 2: If necessary, provide any disentitlement information.
Remarks line 3: If necessary, provide any extension information. Provide the NO-CR-CODE and the WP deferral.
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
